webComponents.description: One agent's state at a glance in a multi-agent workspace; the focused agent belongs in the thread or the panel.
A framed viewer for a generated artifact: a sandboxed preview beside its source.
The files attached to a message.
An animated visual for live audio, which can also animate on its own when the source cannot be tapped.
A person or entity avatar: a rounded image that falls back to initials.
A compact pill for status text, counts, or source citations.
A button that triggers an action.
A presentational surface for framing one piece of content, with optional media, header and footer regions.
A list of generative-UI cards, one child element per card type.
Step-by-step reasoning drawn as connected steps, each with its own collapsible detail. `kai-reasoning` is the single thinking block instead.
A complete chat surface: a message thread with its own header and prompt input.
A single checkbox; `kai-checkbox-group` is the list form.
A list of checkboxes for choosing any number of options; `kai-radio-group` is the same list limited to one.
A bookmark button that marks a point in a thread.
A single-select card of rich options that submits one choice.
An anchored onboarding bubble with an arrow, pointing at the trigger it wraps. `kai-tooltip` is the one-line hint instead.
One syntax-highlighted code block with a copy button.
A grouped, filterable command palette. `kai-menu` is the static action menu instead.
A dual-response comparison in which the reader picks the better of two answers to one prompt.
The bare rich-text editing surface for a prompt.
A card that presents an approval and a small set of actions for it.
A context-window usage meter with a token and cost breakdown.
One selectable row of a conversation list; `kai-conversations` is the container that gives its rows selection and keyboard traversal.
A conversation list or rail.
A centered modal dialog: a panel of your content over a dimmed page. `kai-screen` is the full-bleed takeover instead.
A floating corner launcher: a button pinned to the viewport edge that opens a panel of your content. `kai-prompt-dock` is the in-flow tray around a prompt input.
A trigger with a floating surface you fill with your own markup. `kai-menu` is the same surface driven by an item list.
A text label that swaps itself for an input field when edited.
A lazy media embed: a poster and a play button until the reader presses play.
The empty state of a list or panel: a heading, a line of copy, and room for an action.
An inline thumbs up / thumbs down bar that asks for feedback and thanks the user.
A collapsible, keyboard-navigable file explorer built from a flat list of paths.
A dropzone for picking files or dropping them in.
A form rendered from a JSON-Schema definition and submitted as one validated object.
Reveals rich markup on hover or focus of the trigger it wraps. `kai-tooltip` is the text-only hint instead.
An inline glyph from a small curated icon set, so surrounding markup can match the components.
An image at a URL.
An image the model produced, from bare base64 or raw bytes rather than a URL.
A single-line text field, optionally masked and reformatted as it is typed.
A keyboard-shortcut display: one inset cap per key, in the platform's own glyphs.
A row of keycaps that reads as one shortcut hint.
Enlarges the markup wrapped around it, centered over a dimmed page.
A rich link preview card built from Open-Graph metadata.
An animated loading indicator.
Renders markdown, with syntax-highlighted code blocks.
A cascading action menu driven by an items tree.
A single message row of a chat thread.
A model picker that reports the chosen model outward instead of owning the selection.
A vertical navigation list built from an item tree, with nested groups, status dots and trailing actions.
An inline notice box with a leading status icon.
A framed window for one agent or task in a workspace.
A responsive grid of panes that drops columns and eventually scrolls rather than squashing them.
A tabbed group of panes: a tab strip over the active pane's content.
The frame a widget-panel composition sits on.
The header row of a panel.
A trigger that opens a floating panel of arbitrary content.
A thin determinate progress bar for a task whose remaining scope is known.
A recessed in-flow tray that frames a prompt input, with optional bands above and below it. `kai-dock` is the floating corner launcher instead.
The prompt row: a rich text editor with its send button and toolbar.
A bordered list of rows that selects exactly one of them.
A collapsible block of the model's reasoning text. `kai-chain-of-thought` is the stepped version.
A sandboxed cross-origin iframe card.
A resizable multi-panel layout with draggable dividers.
A config carrier inside a resizable group, standing for one panel.
Reveals streamed text with a typewriter or fade animation.
A generic list row.
A bordered frame that presents a run of rows as one grouped list.
A dropdown that scopes a chat by author or tag.
A full-bleed overlay destination that takes over its mount point under a back header. `kai-dialog` is the centered modal instead.
A scroll container with a themed, thin, cross-browser scrollbar.
A floating button that scrolls a container to its bottom, visible while the container is scrolled up.
A debounced search field with a clear button and an optional keyboard-shortcut hint. `kai-input` is the plain text field.
A row of mutually exclusive pills for switching between a few options in place.
A select control built on a real native `<select>` element.
A divider between groups of content.
One labelled row of a settings group, with an optional trailing control.
A settings section: a heading over a card of setting rows.
A pulsing placeholder that holds a layout while content loads.
Badges showing which skills were active for a message.
A slider built on a real `<input type="range">`.
A citation link that previews the source it points at.
A gathered list of citation links.
A small presence or unread dot.
A row or list of suggestion chips.
A toggle switch.
A bottom navigation bar of equal-width tabs that owns its own selection.
One tab of a tab bar.
An accessible tab strip that reports the selected tab and renders no panels of its own.
A checklist of tasks the user ticks off and confirms.
Animated shimmering text, for a loading placeholder.
An animated indicator that the model is still working.
The scrolling message list of a chat.
The viewport overlay that stacks toasts.
A collapsible panel showing one tool call's input and output.
Wraps a trigger and shows a short hint on hover or focus, as plain text or as markup.
One named view inside a view stack, shown or hidden by the enclosing stack.
A mobile-style view navigator that shows its child views as tabs or pushes them on top of one another.
A microphone button that records and transcribes speech.
A speaker button that reads text aloud.
A resizable app layout shell with collapsible side asides.
